lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 5 distinct vertical lines visible on the lateral torso; spacing is non-uniform with wider gaps between the anterior segments than the posterior segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the fourth vertical line from the anterior, splitting in the upper-medial quadrant of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the final posterior line are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8-10 high-contrast white spots is concentrated on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots are aligned diagonally along the muscle contour of the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a lateral outward spiral from the base followed by an inward and upward terminal trajectory.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal tip-to-tip span is approximately 2.2 times the width of the horn base structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping occupies approximately 0.15 of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest mane and long dark ventral fringe; high-contrast orange pigmentation on all four lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
